Lenovo Maintains Revenue Momentum on AI-Fueled Hardware Demand

Segment revenue more than doubled from a year earlier

By

Lenovo Group 992 -0.37 % decrease; down pointing triangle reported robust sales in the fiscal second quarter, on track to achieve its $100 billion annual revenue goal thanks to strong artificial-intelligence infrastructure demand.

Surging demand for AI servers and enterprise infrastructure has enabled the world’s largest personal-computer maker to achieve better-than-expected results recently, offsetting a broader downturn in global PC shipments.
